title: Why Fast Threat Detection Matters in Modern Cyber Attacks
excerpt: Exaforce highlights how rapid credential theft and data exfiltration demand automated containment and machine-speed security responses.
body_html:
Modern cyber attacks can move rapidly, allowing malicious actors to steal credentials and start exfiltrating data within a matter of minutes. According to Exaforce, these incidents often unfold faster than human security teams can manually investigate and respond.

Real-world incidents analyzed by Exaforce involve various techniques, including stolen GitHub tokens, malicious artificial intelligence installers, and multi-factor authentication phishing. These vectors demonstrate the speed at which threat actors can compromise systems.

Because traditional response times may be too slow to stop these fast-moving threats, experts emphasize the necessity of faster detection methods and automated containment strategies to protect sensitive data effectively.
